correctness.rationale: The beta-moment expansion and twice differentiated series converge absolutely for alpha>2; full DFT Hessian diagonalization gives three spectral modes. The two nonzero eigenvalue integrands A+B and B are positive. The ratio B/A is strictly increasing and crosses one once, giving a strict single-crossing argument for the unique F zero. Exact rational partial fractions and interval bounds prove F(2)<0<F(3), independently checked by the included standard-library script. The Hessian Taylor expansion proves the sharp local coefficient. The alpha=2 computation refers only to the continuous integral endpoint.
